notes: CRITICAL: Word order is LITTLE-ENDIAN for 32-bit values. For 0x12345678: %MW0=0x5678 (low), %MW1=0x1234 (high). No single system status register - status distributed across %S bits and %SW words. Addresses are configurable via %SW138-141.
